results.title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – AN TOBAR – INVITATION TO TENDER FOR CREATION OF AN EDUCATIONAL WEBSITE TO AID THE TEACHING OF IRISH IN ENGLISH-MEDIUM PRIMARY AND POST-PRIMARY SCHOOLS
results.buyer: An Chomhairle um Oideachas Gaeltachta agus Gaelscolaiochta
unknowns: SPM must confirm it can obtain and evidence the required employers liability, public liability and professional indemnity insurance for the contract.
SPM must complete all bidder-specific legal, tax and compliance declarations required by the Irish procurement process.
The site must be fully bilingual Irish/English; COGG states it will provide content/translation support and automated translation is not permitted.
results.why: Strong lean-direct web opportunity. The latest official amendment resolves the live submission deadline to 7 September 2026 at 17:30. The DCE expressly confirms that a foreign tenderer may deliver primarily remotely subject to Irish/EU contractual, GDPR, security, accessibility and service requirements. Scope is a conventional responsive CMS/resource website with configurable search and filters, secure administration, accessibility, documentation and deployment. No numeric turnover floor, fixed disqualifying reference threshold, minimum team size or named certification threshold was identified in the reviewed evidence. Remaining insurance and bidder-compliance facts prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but are not an established hard blocker to GREEN.

results.title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – Provision of Website Design, Development, Hosting, Maintenance and Digital Resource Portal Services – Primary Mathematics Hub
results.buyer: An Chomhairle um Oideachas Gaeltachta agus Gaelscolaiochta
unknowns: SPM must present credible relevant web/digital-resource experience and a delivery team in the tender response.
SPM must confirm the exact required insurance cover and evidence it if awarded.
SPM must price and resource four years of hosting, maintenance, support, security updates, documentation and minor enhancements without underestimating lifecycle cost.
results.why: High-value native web opportunity with a EUR 200,000 VAT-inclusive four-year budget. The latest official change notice extends the live submission deadline to 7 September 2026 at 17:30. The DCE scope is directly deliverable through a lean web stack: website/CMS, toolkit integration, downloadable resource library, hosting, accessibility, security, documentation, training and ongoing maintenance. The reviewed evidence asks for relevant experience and a credible project team but does not expose a fixed numeric turnover floor, minimum team size, named certification or hard reference-count/value threshold. Bidder-specific experience, insurance and four-year capacity remain to be evidenced, so GREEN is defensible but FINAL_SUPER_GREEN is not.
